description.value: Glencoe is a resident-owned motel and RV/campground situated directly across from Harrison Hot Springs' public mineral pool on Hot Springs Road. The property offers both motel rooms and serviced RV/tent sites, making it one of the few accommodations in town catering to both motorized and non-motorized visitors. Its central location in Harrison Hot Springs puts touring cyclists within walking distance of the lake, hot springs, and village amenities.

address.value: 259 Hot Springs Road, Harrison Hot Springs, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active motel and campground at 259 Hot Springs Road, Harrison Hot Springs, BC, operated by resident owners. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, laundry, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM community tag says 'Chilliwack' but the business is clearly located in Harrison Hot Springs, which is a separate municipality.
concerns: OSM community tag lists 'Chilliwack' but the business address is Harrison Hot Springs — a distinct municipality roughly 25 km east of Chilliwack; the OSM community tag appears incorrect.
OSM name is 'Glencoe' while the business consistently presents itself as 'Glencoe Motel' on the website.
OSM record contains no phone or address; both were sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is active and in a cycling-relevant destination (Harrison Hot Springs), but the website contains no evidence of any bike-friendly amenities or secure storage. Direct outreach is needed to determine whether it meets WWC required criteria.
enrichment_extras.notes: Campground rates on the website are dated '2021-2022'; may be outdated but the business otherwise appears operational.
